name: random-forest
description: Random Forest Ensemble Classifier and Regressor built using bootstrapped Decision Trees and random feature selection.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to train an ensemble of Decision Trees for classification or regression, providing robust predictions and reducing overfitting.

parameters.name: nEstimators
parameters.description: The number of trees in the forest (default: 10).

parameters.name: maxDepth
parameters.description: The maximum depth of the individual trees.

parameters.name: criterion
parameters.description: The function to measure the quality of a split: 'gini', 'entropy' or 'mse' (default: 'gini').
